items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Smitty taught me a lot about music, taught me a lot about jazz, because there was a lot of stuff I didn't know.

ctx.x: Really? Take everything you hear with a grain of salt. (laughter)

If you have to explain it to them, it’s not worth it, man. Don’t do it. Just you know? Yeah…. Tain and I have a thirty-year personal and working relationship that’s very amazing. I mean, Smitty and I…. I haven’t seen Smitty in a long time, since he moved to L.A. He kinda stayed out there. But, I mean, Smitty taught me a lot about music, taught me a lot about jazz, because there was a lot of stuff I didn’t know. He had access to information and he was very diligent. He practiced every day. It was inspiring to…
